notes.title: V1.4.27 Patch Notes - Halloween update part 2!
notes.notes:
What's new?

* New feature - Crystalmail, Rockmail and Diamondplate armours added - exceptionally tough and rare armours.

* New feature - Crystal Falchion and Diamond Falchion added - tough and rare weaponry.

* New feature - Versus screen before every fight!

* New feature - Item graphical refresh for over 400 hundred items!

* New feature - Enemy horrifying sounds mix.

* New feature - Skull buttons, hanging bodies, roof supports, carved faces, smoke trails & stables.

* Optimisation - Faster level initialisation process.

* Optimisation - Includes latest Shockwave Flash standalone player.

* Balancing - Trip wires removed from random areas, replaced with new Coffin traps!

* Balancing - Base damage reduction on weapons that can strike 3 times per second (consecutive damage with weapon skills could ratchet up too quickly on these weapons).

* Bugfix - Rare script error with generated areas.

* Bugfix - Terror snake idle sound.

* Bugfix - Ranking up an active werewolf spell would not increase the active damage bonus.

* Bugfix - Shrunken invulnerashield could be damaged!

notes.title: V1.4.26 Patch Notes - Halloween themed update!
notes.notes:
What's new?

* New feature - Dungeon, outdoor and chasm fog rolls into the levels.

* New feature - New scarier music tracks and horror themed mixes.

* New feature - The Tasty Grunter, Wooly Grunter, Bottle Grunter & Evil Grunter are little pets to find. Feed them your unwanted items and receive gifts in return, but be careful of the Evil one...

* Balancing - Melee Weapon skills now apply their damage bonus cumulatively against a single target when it is struck multiple times. For example, if a sword did 10 damage and the skill bonus was +2 at Rank 1, the first hit would deal 12 damage, the second 14, the third 16 (etc). This brings the melee weapon skills a much needed boost and makes them ideal skills for putting warrior types against big enemies.

* Balancing - Save crystal added near beginning of courtyard level.

* Balancing - All two handed weapons have received a speed boost.

* Bugfix - The initial text in Hilltown was phrased in a slightly confusing way.

* Bugfix - Magic mouth voice overlap.

* Bugfix - Transmutation of magical items could lead to a magical gem being 
created which would have no effect on gameplay but would have an unusual name.

* Bugfix - Vanishing water layer when walking into walls.

* Bugfix - Volume of corridor blades set too low.

* Bugfix - Green slime disappearance - no enemies to kill at the start of a fight beneath the Castle.

* Bugfix - On-screen navigation & death.

* Bugfix - Class name alignment in character generation.

* Bugfix - Loot screen not appearing bug.

notes.title: V1.4.25 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's new?

* New feature - Magical items of Crystal and Diamond. Long lasting and durable, it is hard to break these items as they feature an absorption level that completely withstands incoming damage to the item.

* New feature - Female werewolf portrait added.

* New feature - Main trailer moved to main menu background with new credits roll.

* New feature - Command line switch to enable logging of debug messages to a file for troubleshooting: -l

* New feature - Command line switch to disable wheel mouse support for troubleshooting: -noWM

* New feature - Command line switch to skip the intro altogether for troubleshooting: -sk

* Optimisation - Sound fonts removed from initialisation process and from game; too little useage to be worthwhile.

* Bugfix - Rendering of Stinkbog water.

* Bugfix - Priority sound ordering.

* Bugfix - Removing a spell would not clear the spell selected icon.

notes.title: V1.4.23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:

* New feature - Chaos spell. Make a mockery of enemy battle plans...

* Bugfix - High priority sounds being interrupted by other sounds.

* Bugfix - Kill voiceover could interrupt itself!

* Bugfix - Anna of the lake would not talk about the Stormhammer.

* Bugfix - Dragging another item onto character background item could trigger a script error.

* Bugfix - Rarely a random area could be created with a switch that occupied the centre of a grid location.

* Bugfix - Werewolf XP bar moving with Loot XP bar.

notes.title: V1.4.22 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's new?

* New Spell - 12 Ball. Spray 12 projectiles out from you in all directions!

* Extremely rare Platinum items can now be found. Platinum is better even than Gold!

* Mana cost of higher rank spell now shown before ranking up a spell on the character screen, making it consistent with ranking up through a scroll.

* New hazard - Fire breathing statues.

* Third wall pillar type added, see it on some dungeon levels.

* Rendleshire now features little rock piles and less mud.

* The Baron has been a very bad man indeed. Check out the courtyard level and Northern Lurkwood to see what he's been up to...

* Bugfix - Ranking up health.

* Bugfix - Corridor traps & trip wires in random areas.

notes.title: V1.4.21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's new?

* New and improved spell and skill icons.

* Force Axe spell added. Conjure a magical axe to aid you in battle!

* Curse spell receives a welcome boost: causes enemies to explode upon death in addition to taking additional damage from any source.

* Necromancer variant added - Summoners. Tougher than the necromancer (but worth more XP) these guys will summon in nasty critters to make battles more difficult for you.

* Bugfix - Magic dust(!)

notes.title: V1.4.20 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's new?

* Improved dungeon walls in high detail mode.

* Magical items now have a green light behind them to make them easier to pick out both on the ground and when within the inventory.

* The currently selected skill set on the character screen is now highlighted green.

* New item property - Amplification. Doubles the effects of all applicable player skills on this item.

* New item property - Vengeance. Inflicts double damage when wielder's health is 25% or less.

* Charge up speed doubled for weapons that have this property & status message added.

* Shatter weapons toughened up; may deal more hits before breaking.

* Bugfix - Mana regenerate icon on the character screen was the Boom icon. Mana icon now has a dedicated icon and the older Mana icon has become Mana Regenerate.

* Bugfix - Ancient map graphical glitches.
* Bugfix - Lightning effects 'sticking' on screen at the start of a fight.
* Bugfix - Texture coordinates on straight wall pillars.
* Bugfix - Hammer damage boost from the Club/Mace/Hammer skill.
* Bugfix - All wands were showing 'of mana' as part of their naming.

notes.title: V1.4.18 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's new?

* GEM BAG. Gems no longer go into the inventory and take up space! Instead they are now placed into a special gem bag. Existing saved games which are loaded in have their inventory gems converted into the gem bag, freeing up crucial inventory space for all characters. The gem bag is viewable within the inventory window.

* Options screen - alpha slider has been changed to a texture brightness slider. This primarily affects the walls and environment and changes take place upon loading a new level / game.

* New spell - Charged Bolt. Charge it up to deal double damage!

* Improved frame rates on lower spec video cards due to some dungeon items now using less texture memory than before.

* Fine items can now appear at level 2, magical items at level 3.

* Claw damage boost property added to item generator.

* Beam, Boom, Storm Force and Fire Cloak now cost less mana to cast.

* Bugfix - Level up on screen effect appeared in the centre of the screen and not located on the triglobe.

* Bugfix - Shrunken Star Robes had a reduced max armour value.

* Bugfix - Voiceover & Bearstrike sound file location.

* Bugfix - Sound volume can become very quiet sometimes in the inventory.

notes.title: V1.4.17 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's new?

* The introductory story, the Rendleshire Ruins story and the ending story are now all voiced.

* New conversation options; there is now an NPC that knows something about each artifact that can be assembled. If you have the first fragment on your character when you can ask the NPC about it.

* Improved character 'sheet' look.

* Improved 'Bear Strike' graphical effect.

* Bugfix - The shaft of the Stormhammer was set to the graphic for part of the Axe of Passage.

* Bugfix - Due to the way the save game routine works, the exact armour value of wrecked greaves, helms and boots could be left unsaved. This would then lead to the item not being coloured red in the inventory, but mousing over the item did correctly state that the item was wrecked and the item would also be correctly treated as wrecked in battle. The colouring was incorrect.

* Bugfix - Footstep noises would run into each other.

* Bugfix - Pentagrams would hide the triglobe display instead of shaking it if the first damage sustained in a game was from the pentagram

notes.title: V1.4.16 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What's new?

* Full screen blood spatter effect when injured.
* Random areas can no longer create secret switches; this has proved too confusing in testing!
* The health bar now 'shakes' on player damage.
* Beam and Firecloak both do increased damage beyond Rank 1.
* On being hit, the bottom interface now shakes - ouch!
* Boom spell mana cost reduced to 160 on Rank 1.
* In combat simultaneous kill counts added.
* Weapon/Inventory button now 'shakes' when collecting an item.
* Bugfix - Lightning Nimbus and Stormforce not firing electrical bolts out.
* Bugfix - Dousing a held item in Holy Water would not work.
* Bugfix - Rendleshire ruins intro background staying visible while loading proved to be confusing in testing.
* Bugfix - Automap incorrectly showing bridges.
* Bugfix - Healshield visual effect when exploring slightly too low.
